# Source: original fixture

Authored for the trustabl test corpus. Synthetic files for AGCFG-022, AGCFG-023, OBS-015 and
OBS-016: an AGENTS.md with a curl-to-shell sentence, a credential-file read, an approval bypass
flag, an install the requirements file does not declare and an extra package index, beside
sentences that forbid the same actions or install declared packages; a Python file with
OpenTelemetry tracing, a shell tool and a judge function on a `-latest` model alias; a test-path
file that repeats the judge alias (not judged); and a `safe/` folder with a pinned judge. No external code. Public-domain.
